propositions.claim: The held text is the Federal Register printing of EO 7822, signed February 25, 1938, printed in the issue of March 1, 1938 at page 547.
propositions.quote: Washington, Tuesday, March 1, 1938 PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES. E x e c u t iv e O rder LIMITING THE IMPORTATION OF RED CEDAR SHINGLES FROM CANADA

propositions.claim: The order's only command is a quota of 916,246 squares on Canadian red cedar shingles admitted to entry.
propositions.quote: it is hereby ordered that the quantity of red cedar shingles imported from Canada which may be admitted to entry

propositions.claim: The quota is confined by the order's own words to the first six months of calendar year 1938, so it ran out on June 30, 1938.
propositions.quote: during the first six months of the calen­dar year 1938 shall be limited to 916,246 squares.

verdicts.reason: Held Federal Register text and cited official PDF identify EO 7822, February 25, 1938, published March 1, 1938, page 547.
The complete operative sentence limits Canadian red cedar shingles admitted to entry to 916,246 squares; no other command appears.
The command expressly applies 'during the first six months of the calendar year 1938'; its period ended at the close of June 30, 1938. No contingent event requires proof.
The second recital expressly describes section 811 as requiring a new order for each succeeding half-calendar year. This corroborates the command's explicit temporal scope.
The complete order names only EO 7575 in a historical recital and contains no amendment or revocation of it.
